observations.behavior: Adds a parameterized unit test, `test_read_budget_throttle`, to the replay vision backend. It tests the throttling behavior of the scanner workflow when the read budget is exceeded, specifically checking if the workflow skips querying candidates when the watermark is not advanced and if it does query when the watermark allows advancement. It also tests an override parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision is a PostHog product. This test checks the reliability and correctness of the workflow that manages the replay recording session, specifically the throttling mechanism that prevents over-consuming the database read budget. This could help prevent production incidents related to database overload or workflow failures, but the test is not a production implementation.
